name: holdout_partner_reporting
description: Holdout: scheduled processing, external data input, and outbound partner reports.
resource_constraints_text: Deploy Docker containers on AWS Linux VMs in Seoul. Monthly infrastructure cost shall not exceed 350 USD. High availability is not required, but failed nightly jobs must be recoverable.

classified.text: Analysts define a portfolio and its reporting currency.
At the end of each business day, the system requests closing exchange rates from the external Market Data Service.
The system calculates each portfolio's daily valuation using the received rates.
Analysts review valuation results and data-quality warnings.
Analysts approve a completed daily valuation for publication.
Partner Systems receive an approved valuation report through a signed webhook.
Operations Staff rerun a failed daily valuation after correcting its input data.
Valuation inputs, results, and approvals shall survive application and VM restarts.
A daily valuation shall complete within 20 minutes for 100,000 portfolio positions.
Published reports shall be immutable and retained for one year.
Market-data and webhook credentials shall be supplied at runtime.
The application shall run as Docker containers on Linux VMs and expose job health metrics.
